result.summary: The page mostly looks normal, but there is one notable layout issue where content at the bottom is being obscured by the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card in the "Popular right now" section is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the content look cut off and potentially harder to access.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so the last card clears the fixed nav bar, or make the nav bar non-overlapping.
